title: NZ MBIE Determination 2026/020 (comparative): notice to fix for huts built without consent, Schedule 1 exemption
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Marlborough District Council; comparative only, not Alberta

facts.text: The determination concerns a notice to fix for building work carried out to construct two huts and associated structures without a building consent.
The building work commenced in January 2020 and continued through that year; no building consents were applied for or granted.
The matter is the authority's decision to issue the notice to fix dated 9 February 2026, referred to as the second notice.
Figure 1 is a photo of the building work dated 10 September 2025; Figure 2 is a layout of the huts and associated structures.
The owners state that before the second notice, work removed physical attachments of the deck and veranda from the eastern hut.
